hebrewText: לְ/הַֽעֲבִ֥יר הַ/מַּמְלָכָ֖ה מִ/בֵּ֣ית שָׁא֑וּל וּ/לְ/הָקִ֞ים אֶת כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֗ד עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/עַל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִ/דָּ֖ן וְ/עַד בְּאֵ֥ר שָֽׁבַע

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)

tokens.bdb: Jehudah (or Judah), the name of five Israelites; also of the tribe descended from the first, and of its territory
Dan, one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them
as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
